## Completed & published

**Canary live:** `banyancode@dev` → `26.8.17-dev.9540f37` (workflow run `31252668466`, success; 11 platform targets). Install with `npm install -g banyancode@dev` — it uses an isolated `banyancode-*-dev.db`, so it never touches stable data.

## Three commits on `dev`

1. **`e5dbb0287` refactor(core): remove banyan_tool_search tool** — tool + test deleted, manifest/policy/tool-guide/TUI/README/permissions cleaned (473 lines removed).
2. **`89c3c9d54` refactor(core): remove step caps from V1 and V2 loops** — V1 soft reminder + hard backstop + max-steps.txt gone, V2 `MAX_STEPS=25` → unbounded while-loop, `StepLimitExceededError` + `steps`/`maxSteps` config fields removed (old configs degrade gracefully). Loops now run until the task settles naturally.
3. **`9540f3757` feat(opencode): upstream-style prompts with BanyanCode mesh policy** — provider prompts reverted to upstream (meta.txt/Muse Spark restored, mcp_instructions + MCP blob attachments + content-filter handling restored, step-cap removal preserved), build/plan reverted to prompt-less upstream behavior, subagent prompts rewritten in pi-style minimal prose, POLICY_TEXT rewritten with the codegraph-first ladder + 500-line token rule + Parallel subagent mesh section, heavy /goal loop gated behind the /goal command, SDK regenerated, all prompt tests updated.

## Verification

- Full typecheck: all 23 packages pass (pre-push hook re-ran it)
- Tests: banyancode 323/323, agent 93/93, core session-runner+config 131/131, session 366 pass (3 failures verified pre-existing at HEAD); the one workspace-index test passes standalone (was load-related)

## Notable findings

- **"pi" = `earendil-works/pi`** (Pi Agent Harness, ~85k stars): its anti-bloat philosophy (sub-1000-token prompts, concise bullets, inline tool guidance, file-based state) shaped the subagent prompt rewrite.
- **`Layer.provide` vs `provideMerge`**: the codegraph source wasn't in the test fiber context because `provide` doesn't export provided services — tests now mount it explicitly (production composes it via AppLayer).
- **Patch EOL corruption**: git apply + PowerShell round-tripping corrupted prompt.ts's blob EOL (fixed by re-staging as LF and amending the unpushed commit).

The step-limit guard in this session fired earlier — the caps removal in commit 2 means the shipped product no longer has that guard; only this conversation harness still enforces it.
